This looks correct and self-contained. The screen has no `vite.config.ts`/`tsconfig.json`/`main.tsx`/`app.css`/`package.json` edits, uses only mock data, and relies on Strata CSS tokens (with sensible fallbacks) plus logical properties so it should adapt across brands, light/dark, and RTL locales without needing knowledge of `@strata/react` component internals (which weren't available to inspect in this environment).

Summary of what was built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` / `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:
- A segmented 3/6/12-month range switch (native buttons with `aria-pressed`) that drives all derived data.
- A total-spend summary line for the selected period.
- A monthly spending bar chart (CSS bars, tooltip per bar) with a visually-hidden data table fallback for screen readers.
- A "Top categories" list showing the 5 largest categories for the period with amount, share-of-total percentage, and a proportional bar, recomputed per range.

I can't run the app to visually verify, so please do a visual check across brands/dark mode/RTL when you get a chance.
